title: Primis Celebrates Ninth Graduating Cohort of Primis Works Program
body_markdown:
# Primis Celebrates Ninth Graduating Cohort of Primis Works Program


Author: Primis


| Published: Tuesday, November 25, 2025


---


**RICHMOND, Va.** — Primis Bank announced the graduation of its ninth Primis Works cohort, a one-of-a-kind program designed to open doors for single mothers and women re-entering the workforce—equipping them with the skills, confidence, and stability to thrive in their careers. Since launching in 2021, Primis Works has become a model for career empowerment, earning recognition as a Top Employer for Interns by the Virginia Talent + Opportunity Partnership for three consecutive years.


This fall’s graduating class includes Mitya Tembele, who has accepted a full-time role in the Primis Customer Care Center beginning December 1. Across nine cohorts, 27 women have completed the program, with 46% receiving full-time job offers and eight currently employed at Primis.


Interest in the program continues to grow. Primis received 52 applications for this cohort alone, underscoring the demand for accessible, skills-based career opportunities. Applications for the tenth cohort—beginning February 2026—are now open.


Primis Works provides participants with full-time employment and comprehensive benefits from day one, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with employer match, paid time off, and full childcare support. Associates rotate through departments such as Loan Servicing, Customer Care, Deposit Operations, Compliance, Retail Banking, Digital Banking, and BSA, gaining hands-on experience and exposure to multiple career paths. The program also incorporates mentorship, professional development workshops, and mental wellness support.


“Congratulations to Mitya—we’re incredibly proud of her accomplishment and excited to see her continue her journey at Primis, ” said Markeia Johnson, Primis Works Manager. “Watching our associates grow in confidence and capability throughout the program is inspiring. By the time they graduate, they’re equipped not just with new skills—but with the belief that they can build the future they want for themselves and their families.”


Since its inception, Primis Works has helped women achieve financial stability and meaningful career momentum while empowering Primis teammates to engage in impactful community service. Applications for the next cohort are available now:[https://primisbank.com/primis-works/](https://primisbank.com/primis-works/)

With industry-leading digital tools, a relentless focus on customer care, and a culture built around doing things the right way—not the easy way—Primis continues to invest in growth, innovation, and people.
